switch-workspace.intent: Swipe or use the page indicator to switch primary workspaces

create-session.intent: Create a draft session and open the voice agent panel

start-session-from-domain.intent: Start a voice session from the Domain Desktop

open-agent-panel.intent: Continue the current session by voice or text

toggle-voice-input.intent: Start or stop the primary voice input surface

submit-prompt.intent: Submit the current prompt to the active session

expand-agent-process.intent: Inspect collapsed tool and script execution events

cancel-agent-turn.intent: While running, the send action becomes pause/cancel; otherwise it submits the prompt

select-interface-language.intent: Switch the bilingual interface between Chinese and English
